research_question: Can independently attractive concurrency and residency choices compose into an infeasible plan when they consume the same finite memory budget?

residency_fixture.classification: synthetic shape inspired by FR-P9-003; not a directly comparable physical measurement

primary_oracles: exactly six worker/residency combinations are enumerated
the independently fastest worker count is four
the independently transfer/latency-preferred residency policy is KEEP_WARM
the independently selected N=4 plus KEEP_WARM composition exceeds the frozen memory cap
the joint feasible set remains non-empty
the feasible typed Pareto frontier remains non-empty
claim_boundary: Cross-proxy shapes are used only to construct a synthetic composition falsifier. No physical joint optimum or host memory recommendation is claimed.
next_falsifier: Measure KEEP_WARM and FAULT_IN under the same hosted payload, worker counts, queue workload, and memory-accounting surface.
